justification: Audit run5 (2026-10-16) found a Leichhardt Part G site rule (Jane Street, Balmain) served to 118 Louisa Rd Birchgrove: 31 Part G rules for three named sites were left on the generic layer. Withheld under the user's 2026-10-15 rule. The hide script's dry run also wanted to un-key the 49 Warringah G1 rows keyed to Dee Why in #1296; it now leaves every precinct-layer row alone.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: aborts if the served count for a selector drifts from its expect; prints a non-zero 'to withhold' if a listed row is back on a council-wide layer
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the filter change the dry run printed 'northern_beaches/warringah-dcp-2011-full: served 969, to withhold 49' -- the 49 Dee Why keyed rows (2026-10-16). After: 0.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Leichhardt DCP 2013 Part G: Section 3 'Area 3 on the map in Figure G1' (p13), G10.1 '17 Marion Street ... Lot 25 Sec 1 DP 328 ...' (p116), G11.1 '1-5 Chester Street, Annandale being Lot 11 DP499846' (p124)

real_layer_exempt.scripts/hide_unmapped_area_rules.py: one-line filter change; the script's real-layer check is its own dry run against production, which is the observed_red above; a database-marked test would write to production

pre_impl.existing_data: 883 of 918 Part G rows already keyed to site outlines; 35 generic, of which 4 are the p9 introduction
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: assumed the hide script only touched unkeyed rows; it also un-keyed rows a gate rule had keyed

functions.name: main
functions.input: the served rows each listed selector matches in production
functions.output: the rows not yet on the precinct layer, which are backed up then withheld
functions.if_none: prints nothing to change and writes nothing

break_it.scenario: Marion St and Chester St outlines built from their lot lists
break_it.what_happens: Marion: none of its 6 lots exist in today's cadastre; Chester: builder's fallback check finds 21 Inner West lots within 500 m that findNearestPrecinct would hand the site's rules
break_it.repro: python scripts/build_site_boundaries.py with the two sites added

break_it.scenario: A withheld row is later keyed by a derive rule
break_it.what_happens: the hide script must not undo it
break_it.how: precinct-layer rows are skipped whatever their id
break_it.repro: dry run shows 0 for Warringah after the change

break_it.scenario: Intro rows on p9 withheld too
break_it.how: ids listed explicitly; p9 rows excluded

mutation_analysis: Restoring the old filter reproduces 'to withhold 49' for Warringah in the dry run.
residual_risk: Jane Street, Marion Street and Chester Street rules are not served to their own sites until outlines exist.
